title: Real rooms across the reference repos
description: Every room that exists in any of the four setups, with the repo and path it came from. This file is the evidence base for `room_types.yaml`: a room type's `source_rooms` are drawn from here, so a type that no real room produced cannot be recorded, and the corroboration rule for `default: true` can be checked by joining through this file rather than by trusting a comment.

name.description: The room as the repo spells it. Kept verbatim, including a non-English name: this is the record of what exists, and normalising it here would destroy the evidence the room-type map is derived from.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file the room was read from.
